An effect moves a cell's attributes, not only its colours (rich-animation-42lg.0wr) (#484)

* An effect moves a cell's attributes, not only its colours (rich-animation-42lg.0wr)

An effect's frame maps a cell's look — its colours and its text attributes,
all but reverse — rather than its colours alone, so confined, onBeat,
Animation.all and nesting take an attribute effect with no second copy.
Effected cuts a run where the attributes change too, and a cell whose look
comes back as drawn is still written byte for byte as it was.

blink(spec) sets an attribute on the second hold of a two-hold beat; the
catalogue's new attributes section makes a blink (conceal) and a bold pulse
from it. Style gains attributes / withAttributes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* An effect moves only the attributes a look names (review: rich-animation-42lg.0wr)

withAttributes reads ATTRIBUTE_NAMES off its argument; Effected picks the
look's attributes through cellAttributes, the one place reverse is left out,
and skips the extra Style when a run's attributes are the segment's own.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
